description: OpenAI-compatible chat completions on AI Singapore SEA-LION v4 27B, tuned for Southeast Asian languages (Indonesian, Thai, Vietnamese, Filipino, Malay and more). Set your OpenAI SDK base URL to https://agents.citiviewgroup.com/v1/sea-lion and pay per token with x402 instead of an API key: $1.053 per million input and $1.665 per million output tokens, minimum $0.002 a call, at most $0.0390. The 402 quotes your request's maximum; "upto" payers are charged only the tokens used. Same request/response shape as OpenAI (streaming supported), up to 4096 output tokens. Costs $0.0390 USDC per call (x402).
